observations.composition: The calibrated prompt improves visibility of eyes, lower face, and hair regions, but most formal outputs remain close portrait crops rather than literal waist-up compositions.
observations.artifact_note: ref_09 shows severe facial distortion and a spurious dark lower-face artifact in sampled frames.

decision.rationale: Composition shortfalls and generative artifacts are model outcomes. Frame-level observability is determined by the frozen evaluator; outputs are not excluded after inspection.
